{{dablink|This page concerns the in-universe book. For the cataclysmic period that ended the [[Second Age]] and began the [[Third Age]], see [[Breaking of the World]]}}
'''''The Breaking of the World''''' is the title of a book of which neither the content nor the author is known. It is either the [[Common]] title translation of ''[[Aleth nin Taerin alta Camora]]'', or the title of the original work which was translated by someone named Aleth nin Taerin alta Camora.{{ref/book|1|p}}
